describe_vercel_auth_status: call describe_vercel_auth to check if Vercel OIDC or access token authentication is configured
check_vercel_auth_ok: use describe_vercel_auth and inspect the ok field to verify Vercel auth is valid
inspect_vercel_auth_details: call describe_vercel_auth and read detail_lines to see which Vercel env vars are present or missing
create_vercel_auth_status: instantiate VercelAuthStatus with ok, label, and detail_lines to represent a custom auth state
review_vercel_auth_config: review describe_vercel_auth to understand how VERCEL_TOKEN, VERCEL_PROJECT_ID, and VERCEL_TEAM_ID are validated
